end.summary: Practised how sums of consecutive odd numbers from 1 form square numbers.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised connecting odd-number sums with square numbers and used an L-shape dot model to explain why 5×5 to 6×6 adds 9 dots. They corrected the overlap mix-up by counting 5 + 5 − 1. The sum through 29 was not completed, and the teach-back was not yet passed. At home, ask them to draw the next L-shape and use the rule that the sum of the first n odd numbers is n².
